summary: Voice (speech-to-text) feature end-to-end tested. Backend POST /api/transcribe: 5/5 pytest cases passed (auth guard 401, too_short -> {text:'',reason:'too_short'}, real speech 'I need AC repair at home' from /tmp/q.mp3 transcribed successfully with keywords matched, language=hi accepted 200, invalid language ignored). Frontend smoke (390x844): customer login 9800000001/1234 OK -> /home; home-voice-search-btn present in search bar and tapping it starts recording (icon switches to red stop, no crash, no red screen); support screen /support shows chatbot-voice-btn + chatbot-input and tapping chatbot-voice-btn also enters listening state. mic-permission-sheet did not appear because headless Chromium granted mic permission by default - this is expected per the request (as long as no crash). No React Native issues detected. Deprecated 'shadow*' CSS warning is from internal expo logbox stylesheet, unrelated.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_voice.py: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read via os.environ[...] inside the request handler - fine, but a KeyError would surface as 500 instead of 502; low priority.
VoiceButton.tsx: silence auto-stop logic is tight (SILENCE_MS=1800, 7s no-speech cutoff) and handled correctly; cleanup on blur via useFocusEffect is good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login + both mic buttons render & tap without crash)
